books.title: Complete Town 1: Backerton
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: A medieval fantasy settlement of over 21,000 inhabitants, with detailed buildings, distinctive NPCs, a numbered map, and a Civil Registry Ledger.
books.description:
Step into a town where every building holds a story waiting to unfold. **Complete Town 1: Backerton** presents a fully realized medieval fantasy settlement of **over 21,000 inhabitants**, with established districts, a functioning economy, local traditions, and a detailed numbered map to guide exploration.

At the center of this sourcebook is an **extensive collection of richly developed buildings**, from bustling shops and marketplaces to temples, libraries, and other notable establishments. Each location offers **descriptive details, inventory and loot tables, and distinctive NPCs** with portraits, personal histories, stat blocks, bargaining mechanics, and quests featuring scalable challenges and rewards.

Beyond its key establishments, the **Civil Registry Ledger** links numbered homes to their residents, giving even ordinary households a place in the town's daily life. Designed for Game Masters, Backerton provides a ready-to-use setting for urban adventures, social encounters, and ongoing campaigns, complemented by **ambient music links and downloadable artwork**.
books.coverAlt: Backerton cover showing a bustling medieval market street lined with timber buildings

books.title: Complete Town 2, Buccaneer's Back-Alley
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: A pirate port with detailed buildings, memorable NPCs, a numbered map, and a Civil Registry Ledger for nautical adventures and faction rivalries.
books.description:
Fortune favors the bold, but every deal carries a hidden danger. **Complete Town 2: Buccaneer’s Back-Alley** introduces a fully developed pirate port for fantasy roleplaying campaigns, where smugglers, captains, and competing factions struggle for influence. Explore its districts, bustling marketplaces, and criminal hideouts through a detailed numbered map and accompanying guide.

The heart of the book is its **extensive collection of detailed buildings**, each featuring atmospheric descriptions, **inventory and loot tables, and memorable NPCs** with portraits, backstories, stat blocks, bargaining mechanics, and personal quests with scalable rewards. From waterfront taverns to secretive shops and shipyards, these locations offer opportunities for exploration, negotiation, and adventure.

The **Civil Registry Ledger** connects numbered residences to their inhabitants, making even ordinary homes part of the setting. Designed for Game Masters, Buccaneer’s Back-Alley can serve as a campaign home port or an urban sandbox filled with treasure hunts, faction rivalries, and nautical intrigue.
books.coverAlt: Buccaneer's Back-Alley cover showing cloaked figures in a misty street lit by red lanterns

books.title: Complete Town 3: Azure Shores
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: A coastal paradise with distinctive districts, more than 1,000 numbered buildings, detailed NPCs, and a Civil Registry Ledger.
books.description:
Golden beaches, bustling markets, and elegant seaside estates conceal a world of secrets beneath the summer sun. **Complete Town 3: Azure Shores** brings a vibrant coastal paradise to your fantasy campaign, complete with distinctive districts, a detailed town map, and **more than 1,000 numbered buildings**. From lively waterfront establishments to secluded villas, every neighborhood offers opportunities for exploration, social intrigue, and discovery.

At the heart of the book are **fully detailed key buildings**, each featuring atmospheric descriptions, inventories, discoverable loot, and memorable NPCs with portraits, backstories, stat blocks, personal quests, rewards, and unique Bargaining DCs. The **Civil Registry Ledger** connects numbered residences on the map to their inhabitants, allowing players to knock on doors and discover who lives inside. Downloadable artwork further brings the town to life.

Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, Azure Shores provides a richly developed setting for coastal adventures, diplomatic encounters, merchant rivalries, and hidden mysteries. Whether serving as a campaign hub or a destination for exploration, this seaside town offers countless opportunities for meaningful interactions.
books.coverAlt: Azure Shores cover showing a lively seaside town with orange rooftops and sailboats on turquoise water

books.title: Complete Town 4: Ashbourne
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: A fortified settlement behind three concentric rings of walls, with detailed buildings, memorable NPCs, and a Civil Registry Ledger.
books.description:
Behind three concentric rings of towering walls, a city struggles to endure against relentless threats. Complete Town 4: Ashbourne introduces a fully developed fortified settlement where craftsmanship, resilience, and survival define everyday life. From the hardworking outer districts and bustling trade centers to the guarded inner ring, Ashbourne offers a richly detailed setting filled with workshops, forges, vibrant communities, and hidden tensions.

At the heart of the book are fully detailed key buildings, featuring atmospheric descriptions, inventory and loot tables, and memorable NPCs with portraits, backstories, stat blocks, personal quests, rewards, and unique Bargaining DCs. A numbered town map connects residences to their inhabitants through the Civil Registry Ledger, allowing players to explore neighborhoods and discover who lives behind every door. Downloadable artwork helps bring the setting to life.

Designed for Game Masters using any fantasy TTRPG ruleset, Ashbourne provides a versatile setting for adventures involving guild rivalries, resource disputes, wilderness dangers, and the challenges of defending a community under pressure. Whether serving as a fortified campaign hub or a living sandbox for exploration, Ashbourne offers a town where every street has a story.
books.coverAlt: Ashbourne cover showing a fortified city with concentric walls and orange rooftops

books.title: Complete Town 5, Tal Doluth
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: Explore the Spiral City, a subterranean metropolis of approximately 5,000 inhabitants, with dwarven forges, bustling markets, and hidden history.
books.description:
Deep within an ancient mountain, an entire city winds its way into the earth. **Complete Town 5: Tal Doluth** introduces the **Spiral City**, a thriving subterranean metropolis of approximately **5,000 inhabitants**, built upon dwarven craftsmanship, precious gemstones, and centuries of hidden history. Its interconnected districts, bustling markets, roaring forges, and mysterious tunnels create a richly developed setting for underground exploration and adventure.

Discover **fully detailed key buildings** with atmospheric descriptions, inventory and loot tables, and memorable NPCs featuring portraits, backstories, stat blocks, personal quests, rewards, and unique Bargaining DCs. A **numbered city map** and accompanying **Civil Registry Ledger** connect residences to their inhabitants, allowing players to explore neighborhoods and discover who lives behind every door. Downloadable artwork further enriches the experience.

Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, Tal Doluth offers a living underground setting for treasure hunts, ancient mysteries, merchant rivalries, and political intrigue. Whether serving as a campaign hub or a destination for deep-earth adventures, the Spiral City invites players to uncover what lies beneath its streets.
books.coverAlt: Tal Doluth cover showing stone stairways and bridges winding through a vast underground cavern

books.title: Complete Town 6, Venturia
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: Explore the Skyborne City, a floating metropolis with four districts, four noble-controlled islands, and approximately 3,000 inhabitants.
books.description:
High above the clouds, a city of sacred flames, floating islands, and ancient magic lives by one unforgiving law: those who defy its order are cast down to the world below. Complete Town 6: Venturia introduces the Skyborne City, a floating metropolis of approximately 3,000 inhabitants, featuring four distinctive districts, four noble-controlled islands, and a richly developed society. From the sacred Emberheart District to the dragon-guarded Drakeward Bastion, every corner offers opportunities for intrigue and discovery.

Explore fully detailed key buildings, each featuring atmospheric descriptions, inventory and loot tables, and memorable NPCs with portraits, backstories, stat blocks, personal quests, rewards, and unique Bargaining DCs. These interactive establishments bring the city's shops, residences, and institutions to life, while downloadable artwork provides additional visual resources.

A detailed city map featuring numbered buildings and an accompanying Civil Registry Ledger connect residences to their inhabitants, allowing players to explore neighborhoods and discover who lives behind every door. Designed for Game Masters using any fantasy TTRPG ruleset, Venturia provides a living setting for political intrigue, arcane mysteries, divine conflicts, and adventures where a single mistake could mean exile from the heavens.
books.coverAlt: Venturia cover showing a towering castle on a floating island

books.title: Complete Town 7: Wavespire
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: A medieval city with 19 districts and 15 noble houses, built for urban exploration and political intrigue.
books.description:
Between towering mountains and the open sea, a sprawling metropolis thrives on trade, ambition, and political rivalry. **Complete Town 7: Wavespire** introduces a richly developed medieval city of **over 20,000 inhabitants**, divided into **19 distinctive districts** and governed through the shifting influence of **15 noble houses**. From the prestigious halls of Regal Reach to the bustling docks and struggling neighborhoods of Lowtown, every district reveals another side of a city shaped by wealth, class, and power.

Discover **fully detailed key buildings**, each featuring atmospheric descriptions, inventory and loot tables, and memorable NPCs with portraits, backstories, stat blocks, personal quests, rewards, and unique Bargaining DCs. A **detailed city map featuring numbered buildings** and the accompanying **Civil Registry Ledger** connect residences to their inhabitants, allowing players to explore neighborhoods and discover who lives behind every door. Downloadable artwork provides additional resources for bringing Wavespire to life.

Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, Wavespire offers a living setting for political conspiracies, noble rivalries, criminal intrigue, and urban exploration. Whether serving as a campaign hub or a sprawling city sandbox, Wavespire provides countless opportunities for adventures shaped by its people, districts, and competing ambitions.
books.coverAlt: Wavespire cover showing a sprawling coastal city beneath towering clouds

books.title: Complete Town 8: Beyond the Gates
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: A two-book toolkit for the roads and wilderness between destinations, with modular encounters, locations, and treasure.
books.description:
The greatest adventures don't always happen in cities or dungeons—sometimes they begin along forgotten roads and unexplored wilderness. **Complete Town 8: Beyond the Gates** is a comprehensive **modular worldbuilding toolkit** designed to fill the spaces between major destinations in fantasy campaigns. Rather than presenting a single settlement, this installment provides an extensive collection of ready-to-use encounters, locations, and narrative situations, organized into two complementary books.

**Book I** introduces a library of thematic categories, each containing unique variations with atmospheric descriptions, adaptable mechanics, artwork, and specialized gameplay elements. From abandoned buildings, dangerous wilderness, and traveling caravans to supernatural phenomena, rituals, and unexpected encounters, these resources help Game Masters bring spontaneous exploration to life.

**Book II** expands the toolkit with **specialized treasure chests**, featuring detailed inventories, traps, and unique mechanics, alongside **an extensive collection of fully developed custom buildings** with NPCs, services, artwork, and encounter tables. A **Civil Registry** provides additional characters and household details to connect these locations into a living world. Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, Beyond the Gates transforms ordinary journeys into memorable adventures
books.coverAlt: Beyond the Gates cover showing riders approaching a city in the snowy mountains

books.title: Complete Town 9: Village Chronicles
books.author: Moonstone Sculptors
books.shortDescription: 30 fully developed fantasy villages with maps, memorable NPCs, and four local quests per village.
books.description:
Every village has a story, from the trades that sustain its people to the secrets hidden beneath its traditions. Complete Town 9: Village Chronicles introduces 30 fully developed villages for fantasy roleplaying campaigns, spanning ordinary rural settlements, extraordinary magical communities, and single-ancestry tribal societies. Each village features a unique map, detailed history, economy, culture, government, and local customs, creating living destinations ready to fit into any fantasy world.

Each settlement includes two fully detailed buildings with atmospheric descriptions, read-aloud introductions, events, priced goods and services, and memorable NPCs. Detailed character profiles and four local quests per village provide opportunities for exploration and interaction, while the accompanying artwork brings these communities to life.

Beyond the villages, discover 10 magical heirlooms, a harvest festival with 45 modular scenes, rural encounters, five original creatures, and five escalating natural disasters. A Civil Registry further connects inhabitants and households. Built on 5e mechanics and adaptable to other fantasy TTRPG rulesets, Village Chronicles offers Game Masters a versatile toolkit for turning ordinary settlements into unforgettable adventures.
books.coverAlt: Village Chronicles cover showing a red-roofed village nestled between cliffs

books.title: Roll for Outfit 1, Adventuring Clothes
books.author: Vault of Many Things
books.shortDescription: 221 magical garments and the Ritual of Style, a system for making appearance matter in play.
books.description:
An adventurer's clothes can open doors—or close them before a word is spoken. **Roll for Outfit 1** introduces **221 magical non-armor garments** across six wardrobe categories: Upper Body, Lower Body, Footwear, Hands and Arms, Head and Neck, and Accessories. Each garment features its own magical properties, rarity, value, materials, sizing, and lore.

Beyond the enchanted wardrobe, the book introduces the **Ritual of Style**, a system that makes appearance matter in gameplay. It includes five cleanliness levels, four production quality tiers, eight garment sizes, and rules for environmental wear, maintenance, and repairs. Clothing condition and craftsmanship can influence Charisma checks, social interactions, and market value.

Designed for adventurers and Game Masters, these garments offer new possibilities for exploration, travel, stealth, disguise, and social encounters. Introduce them as magical treasures, merchant wares, or noble gifts, and give players new reasons to consider what their characters wear
books.coverAlt: Roll for Outfit 1, Adventuring Clothes cover featuring an embroidered traveler

books.title: Order of Euphoria: 25+ D&D Party Hubs
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: 31 fully developed party hubs with staff, services, secrets, adventure requests, and a dedicated playlist for every location.
books.description:
Every great adventure deserves a place to celebrate. **Order of Euphoria** introduces **31 fully developed party hubs** for fantasy roleplaying campaigns, from lively taverns and enchanted theaters to exclusive salons, arenas, and grand festival halls. Each establishment has its own identity, traditions, and place within the surrounding community.

Each hub includes its history, staff, menus, membership traditions, services, weekly activities, magical artifacts, secrets, events, and adventure requests. The book also features **a dedicated playlist for every hub**, alongside supplementary packs containing **10 dancers, 10 clients, and 10 items** to further populate and enrich these establishments.

Designed for Game Masters, these locations can serve as social centers, downtime destinations, or recurring settings for intrigue and adventure. Introduce allies and rivals, stage performances and celebrations, offer unusual services, or turn an evening of entertainment into the beginning of a larger story.
books.coverAlt: Order of Euphoria cover featuring an acrobatic performer in flowing red and purple fabric

books.title: Cat Court: A D&D Plane Where Cats Rule
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: A feline-centered fantasy setting with playable cats, cities, magical items, quests, one-shots, and a complete adventure campaign.
books.description:
In this realm, cats rule everything—from royal courts to back-alley markets. **Cat Court** introduces a complete feline-centered fantasy setting where cats are the rulers, merchants, adventurers, and outlaws, with their own customs, rivalries, and history. Explore a world of whiskered intrigue, hidden secrets, and adventures shaped entirely by cat-kind.

The book features **playable cat variations, character backgrounds, detailed lore, and diverse NPCs**, including villagers, criminals, cultists, and undead cats. It also includes **cities, shops, villages, unique locations, monsters, magical items, quests, and events**, alongside dedicated one-shots and a complete adventure campaign.

Designed for Game Masters and players, Cat Court provides resources for creating feline characters, exploring a fully developed setting, and running adventures with minimal preparation. Play through the included campaign, explore individual quests and locations, or introduce its characters and feline culture into an existing fantasy world.
books.coverAlt: Cat Court cover showing a crowned orange cat in royal robes seated on a throne

books.title: Order of Merchants
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: Influential merchant guilds with detailed leaders, inventories, secrets, and a three-phase Market Module for wealth, stock availability, and negotiations.
books.description:
Every deal has a price, and not every debt is paid in gold. **Order of Merchants** introduces **the Tenured Ten**, a collection of influential merchant guilds for fantasy roleplaying campaigns. From powerful arms dealers and caravan masters to smugglers and information brokers, each organization operates through its own codes, ambitions, and intricate networks of trade and influence.

Each guild features detailed histories, leadership, hierarchies, inventories, magical artifacts, secrets, rivalries, and adventure hooks, alongside character profiles and stat blocks for key figures. The book also introduces the **Market Module**, a three-phase trading system covering **guild wealth, stock availability, and negotiations**, allowing market conditions and player interactions to influence prices and guild relationships.

Designed for Game Masters, these organizations can serve as suppliers, patrons, allies, or adversaries. Use their inventories, contracts, and trading mechanics to create merchant encounters, develop economic intrigue, and build adventures around commerce, loyalty, and competing interests.
books.coverAlt: Order of Merchants cover featuring a masked merchant in an ornate gown against large golden lettering

books.title: Order of Cults
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: 25 fully developed cults with forbidden doctrines, detailed leaders, cursed artifacts, NPC stat blocks, and adventure hooks.
books.description:
Faith can inspire devotion—or bring entire kingdoms to ruin. **Order of Cults** introduces **25 fully developed cults** for fantasy roleplaying campaigns, each driven by forbidden doctrines, ambitious leaders, and unsettling visions of power. From destructive prophets to secretive orders pursuing divine ascension, these factions offer more than faceless enemies.

Each cult features detailed histories, goals, hierarchies, codes of conduct, membership traditions, headquarters, secrets, and unique abilities. The collection also includes **cursed artifacts, detailed character backstories, NPC stat blocks, and adventure hooks**, alongside timelines, public perceptions, and guidance for incorporating each faction into a campaign.

Designed for Game Masters, these cults can serve as recurring antagonists, dangerous allies, or the foundations of entire story arcs. Use their hidden agendas, supernatural powers, and conflicting beliefs to create investigations, political conspiracies, moral dilemmas, and adventures involving forces that threaten to reshape the world.
books.coverAlt: Order of Cults cover showing robed figures gathered around a candlelit ritual platform

books.title: Tavern's Tales Adventure
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: 8 tavern-centered mini-adventures, each unfolding across 4 connected episodes with distinctive characters, secrets, and mysteries.
books.description:
Every tavern has a story worth telling—and some are adventures waiting to happen. **Tavern’s Tales** presents **8 mini-adventures**, each set in a distinctive tavern with its own atmosphere, characters, secrets, and mysteries. From shadowy inns to lively halls of music, these establishments are more than simple backdrops—they shape the stories unfolding within them.

Each adventure unfolds across **4 connected episodes**, drawing on its tavern’s owners, barkeeps, patrons, and unique features. Missing shipments, cursed instruments, hidden cellars, and magical oddities turn familiar gathering places into settings for investigation, conflict, and unexpected discoveries.

Designed for Game Masters, the collection offers tavern-centered adventures suitable for fantasy roleplaying campaigns. Use these stories as standalone mini-adventures or incorporate them into an ongoing campaign, transforming ordinary evenings at the local tavern into memorable encounters filled with intrigue, humor, and danger.
books.coverAlt: Tavern's Tales cover showing adventurers sharing drinks around a table beside a tavern fireplace

books.title: Order of Tavern: 50 Tavern Organisations
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: 50 unique taverns for 5e campaigns, each with 20 detailed features, plus guidance for designing taverns of your own.
books.description:
Every tavern has a story, and some hold secrets worth uncovering. **Order of Tavern** introduces **50 unique taverns** for 5e campaigns, from welcoming roadside inns and coastal retreats to lively gathering halls and shadowy hideouts. Each establishment has its own atmosphere, history, and reputation, offering more than a simple place for adventurers to rest.

Each tavern is developed through **20 detailed features**, including its owner, barkeeper, staff, patrons, accommodations, menus, services, rumors, secrets, and adventure hooks. Unique challenges, memorable characters, and unusual offerings bring these locations to life. The book also includes a dedicated **How to Design a Tavern** section to help Game Masters create establishments of their own.

Designed for Game Masters, these taverns can serve as social hubs, downtime destinations, or recurring settings for intrigue and adventure. Use them to introduce allies and rivals, uncover mysteries, or turn a simple evening at the local tavern into an unexpected quest.
books.coverAlt: Order of Tavern sample-file cover showing a welcoming timber tavern with glowing windows

books.title: Drugs & Dragons Adventure
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: A 20-session campaign following newly graduated dragon riders as they build a mercenary company amid dangerous contracts and political intrigue.
books.description:
Every great mercenary company has to start somewhere—even one with dragons. **Drugs & Dragons** is a **20-session fantasy adventure campaign** following newly graduated dragon riders as they establish their own mercenary company in a volcanic region. With a rented headquarters, mounting debts, and a reputation yet to be earned, their journey begins with the challenges of building a business.

When a charismatic demon named Agron presents an unexpected opportunity, the fledgling mercenaries become entangled in **political intrigue, dangerous contracts, and shifting alliances**. From mysterious deliveries and rogue wizards to powerful demons and rival kingdoms, each session introduces challenges that test the party's skills, loyalties, and judgment.

Designed for Game Masters, the campaign combines **dragon-riding action, mercenary adventures, betrayal, and meaningful moral choices**, building toward a climactic confrontation where the characters' decisions help determine the fate of kingdoms.
books.coverAlt: Drugs & Dragons cover showing a dragon's head above a wooden sign on a door

books.title: Brothel's Tales Adventure
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: 10 fantasy adventures protecting Sir Diego's establishments from monstrous threats, magical disturbances, and ambitious rivals.
books.description:
Behind the doors of Sir Diego's thriving establishments, trouble is never far away. **Brothel’s Tales** presents **10 fantasy adventures** centered on a wealthy magnate and his sprawling network of brothels across multiple towns. Each establishment faces its own dangers, from monstrous threats and magical disturbances to ambitious rivals determined to undermine Sir Diego's empire.

Throughout these adventures, players must **explore dangerous dungeons, confront powerful enemies, negotiate delicate agreements, and forge strategic alliances** to protect the establishments and the people whose lives depend on them. Every challenge brings new complications, blending action with intrigue and decisions that can shape the future of Sir Diego's business.

Created for **fifth-edition fantasy roleplaying** and suitable for adaptation to other fantasy TTRPG rulesets, Brothel’s Tales offers Game Masters an unconventional setting for adventures involving protection, rivalry, diplomacy, and unexpected dangers.
books.coverAlt: Brothel's Tales cover showing a seated nobleman surrounded by women in red gowns

books.title: Queen of Atlantis: An Adventure Series
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: A 13-session campaign in Atlantis where accused adventurers must help the noblewoman Riva claim the throne amid conspiracies and shifting alliances.
books.description:
A king dies without an heir, and an entire city becomes a battlefield for power. **Queen of Atlantis Adventure Series** presents a **13-session fantasy campaign** set in the legendary city of Atlantis. After a disastrous teleportation accident leaves the characters accused of widespread destruction, the ambitious noblewoman Riva saves them from execution—in exchange for helping her claim the throne.

As the party works to secure Riva's position, they become entangled in **noble rivalries, political conspiracies, betrayals, and shifting alliances**. Every assignment draws them deeper into a struggle where hidden enemies, competing ambitions, and difficult decisions threaten their mission. The collection also includes **an art pack, posters, and GM screens** to support the adventure.

Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, the campaign accommodates characters of different levels and offers a story of ambition, loyalty, and the dangerous pursuit of power.
books.coverAlt: Queen of Atlantis cover showing a noblewoman seated on an ornate golden throne

books.title: Iron Omerta: D&D Mafia Organizations
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: 32 fully developed Mafia organizations with faction abilities, NPC stat blocks, artifacts, maps, and adventure hooks from the Order of Criminals series.
books.description:
Behind respectable businesses and polished appearances, criminal empires thrive on loyalty, fear, and silence. **Iron Omertà**, one of the books in the **four-part Order of Criminals series**, introduces **32 fully developed Mafia organizations** for fantasy roleplaying campaigns. Together, the four books explore **100 criminal organizations**, with this volume focusing on powerful crime families, elaborate hierarchies, illicit enterprises, and the ruthless pursuit of influence.

Each organization features **detailed histories, goals, hierarchies, codes of conduct, headquarters, membership traditions, and hidden secrets**. The collection also includes **unique faction abilities, special artifacts, NPC stat blocks, adventure hooks, encounter tables, and maps**, providing practical resources for bringing these criminal empires into play.

Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, Iron Omertà offers organizations that can serve as influential patrons, formidable adversaries, or powerful forces operating behind legitimate institutions. Build adventures around extortion, smuggling, political corruption, rival families, and dangerous power struggles where loyalty is sacred and betrayal can be fatal.
books.coverAlt: Iron Omertà cover featuring an ornate crime boss in a pale coat with a pink fur collar

books.title: NPC Nation: TTRPG Undead NPCs
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: 45 undead NPCs—15 vampires, 15 skeletons, and 15 zombies—across three towns with quests and day and night maps.
books.description:
The undead have more to offer than another battle. **NPC Nation: From Tavern to the Throne, Undeads** introduces **45 ready-to-use undead NPCs**, including **15 vampires, 15 skeletons, and 15 zombies**, each with a distinct personality, detailed background, and recommended quests. Searchable character tags help Game Masters quickly find NPCs with specific appearances and traits.

The collection is divided into **3 chapters**, each centered on a distinct undead town with three sublocations and **day and night versions of its maps**. Every chapter also includes a dedicated quest, providing opportunities to explore the setting and interact with its inhabitants.

Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG system**, the book offers resources for introducing memorable undead characters, building settlements, and creating encounters beyond combat. Use its NPCs, locations, and quests to bring intrigue, unexpected alliances, and personality to your undead communities.
books.coverAlt: NPC Nation cover showing a vampire reclining in an open coffin beside a black bird

books.title: Golden Tokens: 110 TTRPG NPCs & Monsters
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: 60 monsters and 50 detailed NPCs with tokens, plus 10 pre-generated character sheets with hand-painted artwork.
books.description:
Bring new faces and formidable foes to the table with **Golden Tokens**, a collection of **60 unique monsters and 50 detailed NPCs**, each accompanied by its own token. From mischievous creatures to towering threats, the monsters offer a wide variety of encounters and challenges for fantasy roleplaying campaigns.

Every NPC features a **detailed description, backstory, behavioral notes, inventory table, hidden secret, and roleplaying guidance**, making it easy to introduce memorable allies, rivals, and quest-givers. The book also includes **10 pre-generated character sheets with hand-painted artwork**, ready for new players, guest appearances, or replacement characters.

Designed for **5th edition** but adaptable to other tabletop roleplaying systems, Golden Tokens provides Game Masters and players with ready-to-use creatures, characters, and visual resources. Use its monsters, NPCs, and character sheets to populate adventures, create encounters, and reduce preparation time.
books.coverAlt: Golden Tokens cover showing a towering armored tentacled creature beside two fantasy characters

books.title: Golden Dungeons
books.author: Black Cube Games
books.shortDescription: A Level 1 adventure spanning a dungeon escape, an investigation in Wasrora, and a final assault on a bandit headquarters.
books.description:
A simple escort mission turns into a desperate fight for survival. **Golden Dungeons** is a **Level 1 fantasy adventure** that begins when a group of inexperienced heroes is ambushed by goblin bandits and taken prisoner. What follows is a journey from a dangerous dungeon escape to the city of Wasrora, where the adventurers must uncover the identity of the bandit leader and bring an end to his reign of terror.

Structured into **three connected story arcs**, the adventure combines dungeon exploration, investigation, and a final assault on the bandits' headquarters. Designed for approximately **4–6 hours of gameplay**, it can be completed in one extended session or divided into two or three shorter sessions. **Dungeon maps and free high-resolution map files** help Game Masters bring the adventure to life.

Designed for Game Masters using **any fantasy TTRPG ruleset**, Golden Dungeons offers an accessible starting adventure filled with dangerous encounters, unexpected challenges, and opportunities for new heroes to prove themselves.
books.coverAlt: Golden Dungeons cover showing adventurers confronting an armored monster in a ruined dungeon
